stop_reject_exception_index.count_basis_note: Rejection events carry an explicit rejection reason string in the record. Execution exceptions without a candidate are recorded separately and never counted as numeric passes or rejections. Terminal-state observations (budget spent, restored states, reopened states) are recorded separately and never counted as rejection calls unless the record itself contains an explicit rejection reason string at that path. Deduplication: each rejection reason string at a distinct JSON field path is counted once; where two fields in the same record describe the same conceptual rejection, the rejection event and the terminal observation are listed separately with an explicit pairing note rather than silently merged.
